takes.title: Baseball pitch with high knee and forward follow-through
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the hands together, lifts one knee into a windup, then strides forward through an overhand release and returns upright.

takes.title: Repeated baseball pitches with a full windup
takes.actionDescription: The performer resets with hands together between throws, opens the arms into a long stride, and follows through forward with the rear leg lifting.

takes.title: Basketball shot with a short dip
takes.actionDescription: The performer gathers the hands, dips through the knees, then extends both arms overhead and returns the hands toward the chest.

takes.title: Basketball layup from a moving approach
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes quick approach steps, bends low, then rises into a one-sided overhead layup and continues with landing steps.

takes.title: Repeated baseball swings
takes.actionDescription: The performer sets the feet apart and brings both hands together, rotates through several swings, then relaxes back into the setup stance.

takes.title: Baseball bunt mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the hands forward as if setting a bat for a bunt, makes short weight shifts through the wider stance, then lowers the arms.

takes.title: Frisbee throwing mime with repeated resets
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly brings one hand in toward the body and sweeps it out in a short throwing action, resetting to a narrow stance between attempts.

takes.title: Crouched motorcycle reference pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the knees bent, one foot forward and the elbows flexed with both hands raised as if on handlebars.

takes.title: Repeated two-foot jumps
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats short crouches and upward jumps, letting the arms hang near the sides and returning to upright between efforts.

takes.title: Repeated underhand tosses
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with the hands near the torso, swings one arm low and forward in an underhand tossing motion, and resets between attempts.

takes.title: Underhand fast-pitch motion
takes.actionDescription: The performer sets the hands near the torso, leans and swings the throwing arm back, then drives it through a low underhand release and steps out.
